candidates.claim: sw-it-01 sends logs to logging host 192.168.30.77, which is in CORP and outside MGMT 10.10.99.0/24, where logging destinations must be.
candidates.remediation: Remove the 192.168.30.77 logging host from sw-it-01 and point it to the MGMT syslog server 10.10.99.60.
